text:
harper: kicking off staged rollout for session-runtime v4.7.0 -> start 6% (ap-south focus). change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. will monitor errors and token latency.

deploy-bot: rollout_20260615_d9 started -> 6% (ap-south heavy). logs: https://infra.redwood/rollouts/rollout_20260615_d9

jin: initial spike on p95 for /v1/session/create in ap-south-1 +180ms. error-rate flat. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/6001

mike: checking traces 1 seeing increased auth cache misses; auth-db latency up ~50ms on canary hosts. likely backend contention.

harper: can we scoped-route ap-south away and keep the rest of the world on canary? want to reduce blast radius.

deploy-bot: traffic split queued: `/traffic split --rollout rollout_20260615_d9 --region ap-south --percent 0` -> will re-route ap-south back to stable

deploy-bot: traffic split applied -> ap-south pinned to stable; canary traffic now from other regions only.

ops-sam: vote: :raised_hand: pause overall until we confirm backend contention resolved. recommend pause and run 10m synthetic against auth-db replica.

harper: pausing now. `/rollouts pause rollout_20260615_d9 --by harper`

deploy-bot: rollout_20260615_d9 -> PAUSED at 6% (operator: harper).

jin: running synthetic load on auth-db replica; capturing tail latencies and connection pool stats. ETA 7m.

mike: opening a short incident ticket in infra: https://tickets.redwood/INC-9002 - will include traces and sample requests.

[7m later]

jin: auth-db replica showed high connection queue; increased pool size on replica reduced tail latencies. applying same change to canary pool and re-run probe.

ops-sam: config change applied to canary nodes: `auth.pool.max_conn=120` (was 64). monitor for 5m.

[5m later]

jin: p95 back near baseline, error-rate stable. propose resume at 2% for 15m probe, then step to 20% if stable.

harper: agree. resume small probe and keep enhanced tracing on auth flows. `/rollouts resume rollout_20260615_d9 --percent 2`

deploy-bot: rollout_20260615_d9 -> RESUMED at 2% (enhanced tracing on).

release-manager: drafting status blurb: "Staged rollout for v4.7.0 briefly paused due to auth-db contention in ap-south; config tuned and canary resumed with limited probe. Monitoring." Will update status page and ping partners if probe extends.

mike: keeping ticket updated with regression thresholds and rollback criteria. If auth p95 > +200ms or client errors >0.5% we auto-abort.

harper: thanks team. leaving change window open until 04:00 UTC. will schedule post-rollout follow-up to harden auth pool settings.
